claims.text: Stanly Ranch is at 200 Stanly Crossroad in Napa, California, on the southern edge of Napa Valley near the Napa River.

findings.quote: Stanly Ranch is located at 200 Stanly Crossroad in Napa, California, on the southern edge of Napa Valley near the Napa River.

claims.text: The resort is set on a historic wine country ranch founded in 1856 by Judge Edward Stanly.

findings.quote: set on a historic wine country ranch founded in 1856 by Judge Edward Stanly

claims.text: Guestrooms are cottage-like, with in-room seating areas and grand doors that open onto generous private terraces.

findings.quote: cottage-like guestrooms marry rustic charm and progressive design, boasting in-room seating areas and grand doors that open onto generous private terraces

claims.text: Designer Jen Clausen gave the rooms a modern farmhouse look with leather and oak furnishings.

findings.quote: Designer Jen Clausen created a modern farmhouse vibe, using leather and oak furnishings

claims.text: Villas have two bedrooms and a gourmet kitchen.

findings.quote: each Villa is complete with two bedrooms, a gourmet kitchen and expansive terraces

claims.text: Dinner at Bear highlights Napa Valley ingredients using techniques such as grilling and fermenting alongside more traditional preparations.

findings.quote: Dinner is a convivial experience highlighting the ingredients of Napa Valley through techniques such as grilling and fermenting alongside more traditional preparations

claims.text: Gavel is a coffee shop serving freshly baked pastries and Sightglass Coffee roasts.

findings.quote: A buzzing coffee shop complete with freshly baked pastries, local provisions and specialty roasts from Sightglass Coffee.

claims.text: Stanly Ranch has three pools, including a family pool and the spa pool at Halehouse.

findings.quote: Stanly Ranch has three mountain-view pools, including a family pool and the spa pool at Halehouse.

claims.text: Group fitness classes, including yoga, pilates, barre and HIIT, are complimentary to in-house guests.

findings.quote: Choose from a variety of daily movement classes, available complimentary to in-house guests. We offer a range of instructor led classes including different forms of yoga, pilates, barre and HIIT.

claims.text: Stanly Ranch is a dog-friendly resort.

findings.quote: Yes, Stanly Ranch is a dog-friendly resort.

claims.text: Stanly Ranch is a working ranch, and its menus are sustainably sourced and seasonally driven.

findings.quote: working ranch to create sustainably sourced and seasonally driven menus and dining experiences

claims.text: The concierge can arrange a helicopter tasting with Donum Estate.

findings.quote: A great example is the helicopter tasting they can arrange with Donum Estate.

claims.text: Basin Bar sits between the Lavender pool and the kids pool and serves light dishes, wood fire pizzas and cocktails.

findings.quote: Nestled between the Lavender and kids pools, Basin Bar offers light dishes, wood fire pizzas, vibrant cocktails and refreshing wines

claims.text: Halehouse offers individualized wellbeing programs designed by wellness specialists, medical professionals and sports experts, covering nourishment, hydration, sleep, movement and targeted treatments.

findings.quote: leading wellness specialists, medical professionals, and sports experts from around the world tailor individualized programs that incorporate nourishment, hydration, sleep, movement, and targeted treatments

claims.text: San Francisco Airport is about a 1 hour 20 minute drive from the resort.

findings.quote: San Francisco Airport (SFO) is 87 miles to the resort and approximately a 1 hour and 20 minute drive.

claims.text: Downtown Napa is about 10 minutes from the resort and Sonoma about 20 minutes.

findings.quote: downtown Napa and Sonoma are 10 and 20 minutes away, respectively

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the remote location requires transportation to nearby attractions.
